# pdf-extract

Extracts text and tables from PDF documents for downstream analysis. Handles scanned pages via OCR fallback when the text layer is missing or incomplete.
## When to use

Use this skill when the agent needs to read invoices, contracts, or reports stored as PDF files. Do not use it for HTML pages or plain text files.
## Parameters

| name | type | required | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| path | string | yes | Absolute path to the PDF, e.g. /var/lib/docs/invoice_1042.pdf |
| pages | string | no | Page range like 1-5 or 3,7,9. Defaults to all pages |
| dpi | integer | no | Render resolution for OCR, default 300. Higher values cost more memory |
| --raw | flag | no | Skip table detection and return plain text |

```

# session-store

Server-side session and cart persistence layer. Backed by Redis with a Postgres write-through log for durability.
## When to use

Use for anything involving shopper sessions, carts, or checkout state across devices.
## Parameters

| name | type | required | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| session_id | string | yes | The session identifier |
| --ttl | integer | no | Session lifetime in seconds, default 3600 |
| store_path | string | no | Snapshot directory, e.g. /var/lib/sessions |
## Session continuity

Session continuity: when a shopper signs in on a second device, the earlier session hands over its cart to the newer session. The handover preserves cart contents and the shopper sees a single merged cart.
## Examples

```
load_skill(name="session-store")
get_cart(session_id="sess_9f31", --ttl=7200)
```

Snapshots are written to /var/lib/sessions every 300 seconds.
## Error handling

Raises SessionExpiredError when the TTL elapses and StoreUnavailableError on Redis failover. HTTP 503 from the session API triggers 3 retries.
